verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.restate.dev (HTTP 200) with an indexed list of doc links. Docs pages are also served as raw .md, and first-party docs say the documentation and a plugin integrate with coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively, and any evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content dump.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.restate.dev/llms.txt # Restate
